purpose: Define how an Agent turns commit-attention output into a commit cleanup plan without staging, committing, pushing, or mutating task state.
output: commit cleanup plan in the current Agent thread

allowed: run git status and git diff --stat
read per-file diff only after task anchor is allowed

classification.next_action: Resolve branch divergence or detached HEAD before commit planning.
Create or select MC task anchor before dirty diff review.
Run work-anchor preflight, inspect scoped status/diff, and produce grouped commit cleanup plan.
Do not rewrite local commits; verify task/event linkage and ask Vincent whether to push.

decision_order: Classify each repo into blocked, plan_allowed, or push_decision_required.
For blocked repos, stop at reason and next_action.
For plan_allowed repos, run work-anchor preflight before reading detailed diffs.
Inspect dirty scope and propose logical commit groups.
Wait for Vincent confirmation before entering worktree-commit.
Actual git add/commit/push remains outside this gate.
